lawyer:
Md. Khurhsid Alom Khan with Kazi Arifur Rahman, Advocates—For the Petitioner 
Fazlur Rahman Khan, DAG with Md. Ali Zinnah, AAG with Osman Gani Khan, AAG—For the State
parties:
Siddiqur Rahman Sheikh (Md.) ----- Informant-Petitioner
Vs.
Md. Lokman Sheikh and another ----- Opposite Party
full_judgment:
Md. Rezaul Hasan J:  In this petition filed under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, by the accused-petitioner, instant Rule has been issued calling upon the opposite parties to show cause as to why the judgment and order of acquittal dated 3-3-2014 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Bagerhat, in Session Case No.148 of 2008, arising out of Morelgonj Police Station Case No. 8 dated 5-5-2007, corresponding to GR No. 90 of 2007, under sections 302/114 of the Penal Code, should not be set aside and/or such other or further order or orders be passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. The facts leading to issuance of the Rule, in brief, are that, on the basis of an ejahar filed on 5-5-2007, the Morolgonj Police Station Case No. 8 dated 5-5-2007 has been entered, from which arose GR Case No. 90 of 2007, under section 302/114 of the Penal Code. The prosecution case, as narrated in the FIR, in brief, is that on 2-5-2007, at about 4-30 pm, the informant's son Md. Ali Hasan was playing cricket in a piece of land owned by one Basar Sander, that the accused No.1 Md. Rasel Sheikh was also playing cricket in the same group under the captainship of the informant's son Md. Ali Hasan, that since the standard of batting of Rasel Sheikh was not upto the mark, the captain debarred him from batting. Consequently, it has resulted into an altercation between Ali Hasan (victim) and the accused Md. Rasel Sheikh, and at one stage, Md. Rasel Sheikh held the collar of the victim's shirt and told ‘তুমি কি হইছে’ and hearing this the accused No. 2 Md. Lokman Sheikh, father of the accused No.1, entered into the filed and directed his son তোকে যদি ব্যাট করতে না দেয় and pursuant to this order the accused Md. Rasel Sheikh inflicted a fatal blow by the weighty cricket bat on the head of the victim and at once the victim fell on the ground, with bleeding flowing out from his nose and mouth; that seeing this occurrence, the witnesses named Shahid Sarder, Juel Sarder, Aminul Howlader, Sohel Sarder, Robins Sheikh, Rezaul Karim, Reyad and others took the victim to the nearby residence of one Shahid Sarder and then he was taken to a local village doctor, named Sunil Kumar Bairagi, for immediate treatment; that the informant and his brother, after hearing this, rushed to the said house and heard the occurrence from the witnesses and took the victim to Pirojpur Adhunik Hospital and then to Khulna 250 bedded Hospital, on 2-5-2007, at about 11-30 am, and got the victim admitted there, but the doctor on duty referred him to Dhaka Medical College Hospital; that thereafter the victim was taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital and admitted into the DMCH on 3-5-2007, at about 10-30 am but the victim has ultimately succumbed to the injuries on 4-5-2007, at 3-00 am. In this manner the accused persons have committed offence under sections 302/114 of Penal Code and the informant lodged the First Information Report (hereinafter referred as FIR) under sections 302/114 against the accused persons, as stated at the outset. The said FIR has been annexed with the petition, marked as. Armexure- 'A'. Thereafter, the police has taken up investigation, inspected the place of occurrence, seized the alamats along with blood stained earth and the wooden cricket bat alleged to have been used by the accused to inflict the fatal blow on the head of the victim, prepared sketch map of the place of occurrence along with index, collected inquest report, post-mortem report and having found a prima facie case, the police filed Charge Sheet No.102 dated 4-7-2007, under section 302 against the accused Md. Rasel Sheikh only. The informant filed a Naraji Petition against this charge sheet, which was allowed. Accordingly further investigation was held. Police submitted charge sheet No. 7 dated 14-1-2007, implicating the accused Md. Rasel Sheikh only, i.e. again dropping this accused-opposite party Lokman Sheikh. But, the Chief Judicial Magistrate, by his order dated 11-2-2008, has taken cognizance of the offences against both the accused’s and transmitted the record to the Court of Sessions, Bagerhat, then presided over by the learned Judge Mr. GM Salahuddin, wherein the case has been registered as SC No. 148 of 2008 (Sessions Case No.148 of 2008). The record was received on 8-7-2008 by the Court of Sessions, when the accused Rasel Sheikh was found absconded. The accused Md. Lokman filed bail application. His application was rejected by the then Sessions Judge. The learned Sessions Judge had also appointed State Defence lawyer for the absconded accused Rasel Sheikh and fixed 16-10-2008 for hearing on framing of charge. He has then transferred the case to the Court of Additional Sessions Judge for trial, vide order No. 3, dated 14-9-2008. The learned Additional Sessions Judge Mr. Md. Rezaul Karim has framed charge against both the accused’s. Besides, deposition of the witnesses were complete. It appears from the record that on 20-2-2014, the successor Sessions Judge named Mr. SM Solaiman, of Bagerhat Sessions Division, has taken up the matter, heard the argument in part in that case on 20-2-2014, only in respect of the accused Lokman Sheikh and fixed 3-3-2014 for further argument. Thereafter, on 3-3-2014, (the date fixed for further argument), said Mr. SM Solaiman, performing functions as Sessions Judge, Bagerhat, without fixing any dated for pronouncement of judgment, had passed the impugned judgment and order whereby he had acquitted the accused Lokman Sheikh, giving him benefit of doubt, relying upon the deposition of the defense witnesses. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and order of acquittal dated 3-3-2014, the informant has filed and moved this revisional petition and obtained the instant Rule. 

 4. On 5-6-2016, Mr. Md. Khurshid Alam Khan, learned Advocate, appeared for the informant-petitioner and had placed the petition before us along with other documents annexed therewith, the impugned judgment and order as well as the LCR. He first of all submits that, from a mere reading of the impugned judgment and order dated 3-3-2014, it will be evident that on a date fixed for further hearing the teamed Sessions Judge Mr. SM Solaiman has passed the impugned judgment and order and acquitted the accused-opposite party in a hot haste by slipshod order. He next submitted that, it will be further evident from the judgment and order dated 3-3-2014 that the teamed Sessions Judge Mr. SM Solaiman did not at all discuss the deposition of any one of the prosecution witnesses, though he has simply mentioned the names of some PWs But, he did not discuss their deposition, nor applied his mind to the deposition given by the prosecution witnesses or by the seizure list witnesses or by the doctors who have deposed in support of the prosecution case. Nor he has stated any reason for entertaining doubt as to the complicity of the accused-opposite party and to acquit him, by giving benefit of doubt. This deviation is quite unknown in criminal practices and procedure, he adds. The teamed Sessions Judge Mr. SM Solaiman even did not consult the inquest report, the seized alamats or the post-mortem report proved by the prosecution. He even did not consider the circumstantial evidence that was very much corroborative to the deposition of the prosecution witnesses. He next points out that, the trial Judge has recorded in the impugned judgment that the PW 1, PW 2, PW 3, PW 4 and PW 8 have proved the prosecution case against the accused Lokman Sheikh and deposed in a voice that the accused Basel Sheikh had inflicted the fatal blow on the head of the victim as ordered by Lokman Sheikh. But the learned Sessions Judge Mr. SM Solaiman has acquitted the accused-petitioner without taking into consideration the eye-witnesses version in this case. He has acquitted the accused-petitioner recording that ‘‘ আসামী পক্ষে প্রদত্ত সাক্ষীগণের সাক্ষ্য ইত্যাদি পর্যালোজনায় দেখা যায় যে, খেলার মাঠে একটি ঘটনা হয়েছে এবং তাৎক্ষণিক ভাবেই উক্ত ঘটনা সংঘটিত হয়েছে। পূর্বপরিকল্পনাভাবে হয়নি। ফলে উক্ত ঘটনার সময় আসামী লোকনা শেখের ঘটনাস্থলে থাকার বিষয়টি এবং আসামি লোকমান শেখের হুকুমে উক্ত ঘটনা হয়েছে মর্মে সন্দেহ প্রকাশ করা হচ্ছে।”  The learned Advocate continues that, the talking place of the occurrence has been admitted in the impugned judgment, but the trial judge only said ‘পূর্ব পরিকল্পিতভাবে হয় নি’ In that case, section 304 of the Penal Code would have applied, not an order of acquittal. Besides, all the natural and independent prosecution witnesses and the seized alamats have proved by the prosecution. But, how or why, or on what basis or for what reason the court below has entertained the doubt relying upon deposition of witnesses who were not present at place of occurrence and were not eye-witnesses? he posed these questions and asserts that no reason has been recorded for entertaining the doubt about complicity of the accused Lokman Sheikh on the basis of the opinion of defense witnesses and of the formal witnesses, none of whom were not present at the place of occurrence and to acquit him on the date of argument, by hearing case against him alone. Besides, he continues, the apparent fact of disposal of such a brutal case in a hot haste, not only amounts to travesty and denial of justice, but it is contrary to the Constitutional and statutory right of the victim's family to get justice in accordance with law. He therefore, submits that the impugned judgment and order of acquittal dated 3-3-2014 is efface malafide, unjust, improper, unlawful and the same is liable to be set aside and that the case should be tried afresh by a different judge and an appropriate order may be passed in accordance with law. 

 10. Mere perusal the impugned judgment and order of acquittal shows that, although the prosecution has examined as many as 14 witnesses, the said trial Judge Mr. SM Solaiman has not at all discussed or reflected upon the deposition of any of the prosecution witnesses. He even did not consider the alamats seized and proved by the prosecution. Nor he has considered the inquest report or the post-mortem report. He has even not taken into consideration the circumstantial evidence, to see whether the same corroborates the prosecution case or does not. We further find from the LCR that, PW 1 Md. Siddiqur Rahman  Sheikh, the informant and father of the victim, has deposed narrating the prosecution case, in detail, and as regards the time, place and manner of occurrence and about the relevant facts. PW 2 Md. Rezaul Karim is one of the cricket players and was playing at the same field along with accused Rasel Sheikh (the victim) and others. He deposed, as eye-witness, আসামী রাসেল আলী আহসানের শার্টের কলার ধরে। রাসেলের পিতা লোকমান শেখ পাশের বাগান থেকে বের হয়ে জিজ্ঞাসা করে কি হয়েছে? আলী আহসান ব্যাট করতে দিচ্ছেনা বলে রাসেল বলে। তথন লোকমান বলে যে, তোকে ব্যাট করতে না দিলে ধর শুয়ারের বাচ্চারে। তখন রাসেল শেখ ব্যাট দিয়া আলী আহসানের মাথায় বাড়ি দেয়। আহসান মাটিতে পড়ে যায়। তার নাখ-মুখ দিয়ে রক্ত বের হতে থাকে। তাকে আমরা ধরাধরি করিয়া পাশ্ববর্তী শহীদ সর্দারের বাড়ীতে নিয়া যাই।”  He has corroborated PW 1 in all material particulars. PW 3 Md. Shahidul Islam Sarder, was the captain of another group playing in the same field against the group of which the victim was the captain. He deposed that,  “আসামী রাসেল আলী আহসানের শার্টের কলার ধরে। পাশ্ববর্তী কলাবাগানে রাসেলের পিতা লোকমান কাজ করছিল। সে জিজ্ঞাসা করে ওখানে কিসের গন্ডোগোল। রাসেল বলে যে, তাকে খেলতে দেয় না। লোকমান বলে যে, শুয়ারের বাচ্চাকে খেলার সাধ মিটিয়ে দে। তখন রাসেল হাতের ব্যাট দিয়া আলী আহসানের মাথায় বাড়ি দেয়। আহসান মাটিতে পড়ে যায়। তার নাখ-মুখ দিয়ে রক্ত বের হতে থাকে।”  PW 4 is also a co-player and an eye-witness. He deposed that, “এক পর্যায়ে আলী আহসানের কলার ধরে রাসেল। দুই জনে কথা কাটা কাটি ও ধাক্কা ধাক্কি হয়। পাশের জমিতে কলা বাগানে রাসেলের পিতা কাজ করিতেছিল। তিনি জিজ্ঞাসা করে যে, কি হইয়াছে। তখন রাসেল বলে যে, তাকে খেলতে দিচ্ছেনা। তখন লোকমান বলে যে, ধর শুয়ারের বাচ্চাকে। খেলার সাধ মিটাইয়া দে। তখন রাসেল ক্রিকেট ব্যাট দিয়া আলী আহসানের মাথায় আঘাত করে। আলী আহসান মাটিতে পড়িয়া যায়। পাশেই ৫০/৬০ হাত দুরে শহীদ সদ্দারের বাড়িতে আলী আহসানকে ধরা ধরি করে নিয়ে যাই।” PW 5 Riad Sheikh is also a co-player and eye-witness. He deposed that at one stage of altercation, ensued for debarring Rasel Sheikh from playing, that,  “এই নিয়ে কথা কাটা কাটি হয়। এক পর্যায়ে আসামী লোকমান উত্তর  প্বার্শের তার কলাবাগান থেকে বের হয়ে বলে যে, ওখানে কি হয়েছে? আসামী রাসেল বলে যে, তাকে খেলতে নেয় না। রাসেলের আব্বা লোকমান হুকুম করে ধর শুয়ারের বাচ্চারে। ওকে খেলার সাধ মিটাইয়া দে। পিতার হুকুম পাইয়া আসামী রাসেল হাতে থাকা  ব্যাট আলী আহসানের মাথার বাম দিকে জোরে বাড়ী মারে। সংগে সংগে আলী আহসান মাটিতে পড়ে যায়। তাহার নাক-মুখ দিয়ে রক্ত বাহির হইয়া আসে। আমি, শহীদ সদ্দার জুয়েল তাহাকে শহীদ সদ্দারের উঠানে নিয়া আসি------।” PW 6 Altav and PW 7 Abdul Jabbar Shikder and PW 8 Aminur Islam are witnessed to the seizure list and their deposition also corroborate the prosecution case. PW 9 is the village doctor Sunil Chandra Boragi. At his home the victim was taken for first aid. He deposed that, “গত ২-৫-২০০৭ইং বিকাল ৫-৩০ ঘটিকার সময় শহীদ সর্দারের বাড়ীতে ভিকটিমকে দেখিতে যাই। দেখি ভিকটিমের মাথায় একটি আঘাত ও তাহার নাখ মুখ দিয়ে রক্ত পড়িতেছে। আমি তাকে দেখে Pyclophen Injunction দি ও বলি আমার দ্বারা চিকিৎসা সম্ভব নয় চিকিৎসার জন্য হাসপাতালে নিয়ে যাইতে।” PW 10 Md. Rahim Sheikh was tendered. PW 11 is Dr. AKM Shafiuzzaman, Department of Forensic, DMCH, has proved the post-mortem report and in his deposition, described the nature of injury and the cause of death, that supports the prosecution case. PW 12 Md. Monirul Islam is the 2nd 10 PW 13 A. Salam Sheikh is the 3rd 10. They are formal witnesses. Besides, DW 1 A. Malke, adduced in support of defense, deposed that ঘটনার তারিখে আমি আসামি লোকমান ইউপি মেম্বার হিসেবে দেখতে যাই।” DW 2 deposed that, আমি আসামী লোকমানকে (তার বাড়ীতে) অসুস্থ অবস্থায় দেখি। DW 3, Motaleb Khan also deposed that on the date of occurrence “লোকমান ঐ সময় বাড়ীতে ছিল”  fen DW 4, Said “আমি ঘটনা দেখি নাই।” Though the deposition of the prosecution was detail, in all material particulars, and corroborative and consistent in nature, the alibi, taken through DW 1 to 4 does not inspire any confidence to believe them. Besides, none of these Defense Witnesses stated in their deposition that they went to see the victim's family or the victim's father, which was very natural on the part of any rational and neutral human being. So, the question should arise if these defense witnesses are neutral? or creditworthy? or rational being? Particular when none of them were eye-witness, nor a doctor, nor went to see this accused in Hospital, while being totally in different to the victim's family, very unusual conduct. But, the Sessions Judge Mr. SM Solaiman has not stated any reason, or any basis, as to why he has disbelieved the deposition of PW 2 to PW 5 all of whom were eye-witnesses playing cricket in the place of occurrence or other prosecution witnesses, all of whom were natural and independent witnesses, or why he has entertained the doubt about the presence of the accused Lokman Sheikh at the place of occurrence preferring the deposition of DW 1 to DW 4. Besides, in the impugned order it has been recorded that “খেলার মাঠে একটি ঘটনা হয়েছে এবং তাতক্ষণিক ভাবেই উক্ত ঘটনা সংঘটিত হয়েছে। পূর্বপরিকল্পনাভাবে হয়নি।” This findings by the said trial judge clearly proves the occurrence, the place and manner of occurrence and essentially the relevant facts proved by the prosecution, particularly the PW 2 to PW 5. Moreover, his shyness to use the word "murder" in lieu of the word "occurrence" is obvious and questionable.
